info.name: Contact Transactions - Extended End-to-End
info.description: Run all folders in order with one iteration against a local simulator. Creates four unique users (Alice, Bob, Charlie, Diana), captures tokens/IDs, checks contacts, money, phone validation/change/reuse, history and password/logout. First request resets test data variables. Gateway defaults to http://localhost:8080. Optional deactivation is off: set enableCleanup=true to enable. See accompanying README for expected implementation gaps and setup. No internal tokens, manual wallet repairs or automatic payment retries. Syntax/static checks do not prove live API behavior.

pm.test("History contains expected transactions", () => { const rows=pm.response.json().content; pm.expect(rows).to.be.an('array'); ["topupTransactionId", "bobTransactionId", "charlieTransactionId", "dianaTransactionId", "failedTransactionId", "failedTopupTransactionId", "relinkedTransactionId", "reusedPhoneTransactionId"].forEach(k=>pm.expect(rows.some(t=>t.transactionId===pm.collectionVariables.get(k)),k).to.eql(true)); });

pm.test("Only own transactions and no committed PENDING", () => { pm.response.json().content.forEach(t=>{ pm.expect(t.sourceUserId === pm.collectionVariables.get('aliceUserId') || t.destinationUserId === pm.collectionVariables.get('aliceUserId')).to.eql(true); pm.expect(t.status).to.be.oneOf(['COMPLETED','FAILED']); }); });
